verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev supports retries/error handling configuration and explicitly offers failure alerting via email, Slack, and webhooks (docs-39), plus run status filtering to identify errored/waiting tasks (docs-43) and retry/cancel handles (docs-27). However, there's no clear evidence of a dedicated 'error-handling path' or onError/catch-hook workflow construct distinct from retries, and no independent confirmation that failure notifications work reliably in practice. missing for 10: dedicated error-handler/onFailure task hooks or workflow branching for errors, independent/hands-on validation of alerting reliability.
